one_line_description.value: monday.com is a work OS where teams create and shape their own workflows in minutes, code-free.
one_line_description.quote: Welcome to monday.com, a work OS where teams create and shape their own workflows in minutes, code-free.

has_public_api.quote: The monday GraphQL API is part of the monday apps framework. It is an application layer that allows apps to read and update data inside a monday.com account.

api_type.quote: The monday.com API is built with GraphQL, a flexible query language that allows you to return as much or as little data as you need.

api_breadth.value: GraphQL, broad read-write coverage across boards, items, column values, users, workspaces, docs and updates; 60+ hosted MCP tools
api_breadth.quote: Broad platform coverage to read and modify boards, leads, docs, updates, and much more.

docs_url.quote: Connect to your monday data with the platform API

auth_methods.quote: - Seamless Authentication using monday SDK - Seamless Authentication using shortTermToken - Using an OAuth Access Token - Using a user’s global API token

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Required scope:`docs:read` - Returns an array containing metadata about a collection of docs

access_model.quote: If you don't have a monday.com account or simply want to have playground where you can start playing around with our developer tools such as the API and apps framework on a free, no expiration date developer account!

access_notes.value: A free, no-expiration developer account provides self-serve API access and personal tokens for testing. The API is a free feature across all plans, but daily call limits are tiered (Free 200/day up to Enterprise 25,000/day) and can be raised via a paid API add-on. Guests cannot access an API key (OAuth/shortLivedToken only); viewers, deactivated users, unconfirmed emails and student accounts cannot use the API.
access_notes.quote: The daily call limit helps prevent disruptions caused by excessive load from individual accounts, maintains the API service as a free feature across all plans, and controls operational costs

rate_limits.value: Daily call limits by plan (reset midnight UTC): Free 200, Standard/Basic 1,000, Pro/Trial 10,000, Enterprise 25,000; individual query complexity cap 5,000,000 points; per-minute complexity budgets 5M points (app tokens) and 10M combined (personal tokens), 1M for free/trial; paid API add-on can raise the daily limit

webhooks.quote: Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: For building and testing apps or API integrations without touching production data, use a free developer account.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Versioned API with a predictable release schedule and advance notice of breaking changes; requests can pin a version via the Api-Version header (e.g. 2026-07, 2027-01) and older versions are sunset via changelog announcements.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Learn about breaking changes in advance so you can adapt accordingly with a predictable version release schedule.

verdict_reason: monday.com documents a public GraphQL platform API with broad read-write coverage of boards, items, columns, docs and workspaces. Access is self-serve: a free, no-expiration developer account provides an API token, and token/OAuth authentication is documented in detail. Rate limits are tiered by plan but the API itself is described as a free feature across all plans, so no sales contact or review is needed to start building.
open_questions: Official SDK language pages (JavaScript SDK, Python SDK) appeared in the search plan but their page text was not included in the evidence bundle, so sdk_languages is left not_found.

The dedicated webhooks reference page (developer.monday.com/api-reference/reference/webhooks) was not captured in SOURCES; webhooks=true is inferred from the developer site's real-time event/workflow-trigger text at medium confidence.

Production access gates for third-party marketplace apps (app review/marketplace approval) are only partially evidenced; verify whether public app listing requires review beyond the self-serve API token route.
